items.title: HCLTech FY guidance stays muted despite $2.4 billion deal momentum
items.description: HCL Technologies reported marginally better than anticipated financial performance for the June quarter. The company announced a significant investment in a datacentre for artificial intelligence solutions. This new venture aims to address the growing demand for AI model training capabilities. HCL Technologies maintained its full-year revenue and operating margin guidance unchanged. The stock may remain range-bound until client spending trends become clearer.
